producedFor: cross-project handoff of the Landometer Motif Library 1.2.1

approval.boundary: normative for artifacts built on Motif Library 1.2.1; it does not modify LDS 0.9.1 itself

governanceNote: This ladder is not part of the owner-approved artifact overlay 1.2.1 and not part of LDS 0.9.1. It is a placement rule derived from (a) the exact copied asset bytes, (b) LDS v0.9.1 token values in build-kit/lds-tokens.css, and (c) the existing LDS rule that a failing mark is fixed by changing the surrounding surface. The owner approved it on 11 September 2026: it is normative for artifacts built on Motif Library 1.2.1 and does not modify LDS 0.9.1 retroactively. Approval does not replace measurement — measure again whenever the carrier changes.

invariant.consequence: A contrast failure is never solved on the asset. It is solved by choosing a different governed carrier, a different governed record, a different size, or no motif at all.
alsoProhibited: a white or tinted plate placed under the mark
a scrim laid over a governed gradient so page-global ink can be inherited
a new hue invented to make the mark readable
opacity used as the carrier of meaning
any of the prohibited hue families (violet/purple/lavender/plum/orchid/fuchsia/magenta/terracotta/brick/clay/rust/sienna/burnt orange/earth red/brown-orange)

meaningCapable.label: รับงานที่สื่อความหมายได้

decorativeOnly.label: ตกแต่งได้ ห้ามแบกความหมาย
decorativeOnly.basis: perceivable as atmosphere; must stay below adjacent body-text contrast

invisible.label: มองไม่เห็น — เปลี่ยน carrier หรือถอดออก

verdictBands.measurement: Composite the asset's strongest authored element (ink at its authored alpha) over the carrier hex, then compute the WCAG luminance ratio. A gradient carrier is measured at its worst stop.

quietInk.finding: Every landometer.*.quiet variant is drawn in this one ink. Its readability is decided entirely by the carrier: 1.23–1.69:1 on every light LDS surface, 3.19–10.23:1 on the deep set.

quietCarriers.note: The DS-legal surfaces a quiet mark may be moved onto. quietInkRatio is #59D2FE at full alpha; atAuthoredAlpha56 is the same ink at the .56 alpha several quiet variants use.

deep.warning: full variants contain #1D4497 — their base rule measures 1.00:1 here and disappears. Quiet only.

notCarriers: cultivate.glow and cultivate.mist — warm grounds put the sky ink at its weakest and compete with the motif's own energy inks
diversity.spectrum — rationed to one use per long route; never spend it as a motif backing
product.* gradients — only inside the owning product, never as shared atmosphere
any photograph — a photo ground has no single measurable value; use the record's boxed surface variant instead

ladder.name: Re-test, do not re-tint
ladder.action: Measure the asset's strongest authored element against the actual carrier hex, at the actual delivered size. A gradient is measured at its worst stop.
ladder.stopIf: the motif is decorative (aria-hidden, alt="") and lands in decorativeOnly — that is the intended reading, ship it

ladder.name: Change the carrier, not the mark
ladder.action: Move the mark onto another governed quiet carrier. Light ground too faint → the deep set. Deep ground too faint → the light set.
ladder.allowed: any entry in quietCarriers, with its role respected
ladder.prohibited: a plate, a scrim, a new tint, a gradient invented for the purpose

ladder.name: Change the record, not the color
ladder.action: Select a different governed record. This is selection, which is permitted; recolor is not.

routes.ijji.four-beat.selected-3.r3: six surface records exist per motif — canvas, brand-blue, ground-mist, dark, transparent-ink, transparent-mint. Light ground → transparent-ink (#182327, 11.4–15.6:1). Deep ground → transparent-mint (#0AD69C, 3.0–9.4:1). Ground you do not control → the boxed variant that names it.
routes.landometer.motif.v3: swap variant. quiet on a busy, photographic or atmosphere ground; full on a plain light ground. Never a full variant on a Brand Blue panel.
routes.citychat-motif-set: each of 3a / 3b / 3c ships a light and a dark rendition. Choose by the measured lightness of the real ground, not by the theme name: light on #F6F7F3, white, brand.beige or the dark-theme CityChat gradient; dark on #11191D, #172126 or the light-theme CityChat gradient #007A58 → #007E79. The renditions carry their own ground and grid lines, so they are never placed on a photograph or on another Landometer gradient. Status: candidate — owner sign-off pending on AMENDMENT.md.

ladder.name: Change the presence, not the palette
ladder.action: Raise the delivered size toward 1.5× the record's minimum, give the motif its own grid track instead of sharing the text column, or add two spacing steps of clear space.
ladder.note: Size and separation buy perceptibility without touching a single hex. They do not buy meaning — a motif at any size is still framing.

ladder.name: Remove it
ladder.action: Delete the motif. Let text, a TrustBadge, a DecisionCard or a real component carry the meaning.
ladder.test: Delete-the-motif test — if the truth on the page changes when the motif is removed, the motif was doing a job it is not allowed to do.

identityRenditions.rule: The logo is never placed on a plate of its own. Change the surrounding surface, or change the rendition — never the artwork.

measured.hardStop: on --brand-beige #F2F1DF it measures 1.03:1. This rendition is drawn in the superseded v0.6.2 cream; re-export at #F2F1DF is a named pending approval. Never recolour the PNG to close the gap.

measured.use: the quiet universal fallback — the only rendition that clears 3:1 on both the light canvas (4.28:1) and the dark canvas (3.86:1)
measured.when: the surface is not under your control, or the design must survive a light/dark theme switch without swapping files

ijjiIdentity.markOnly: the mark still is transparent — its compatibleHostSurfaces are brand-blue #1D4497 and dark #11191D only. No other carrier is approved.
ijjiIdentity.fallbackWhenNeither: use ijji.logo-sting.tagline, whose still carries its own Brand Blue field, at 320 px or wider.

agentFields.note: Add these to the standard motif brief. Every value is copied or measured, never estimated.
agentFields.hostSurfaceToken: the LDS token of the ground the asset actually sits on
agentFields.hostSurfaceHex: its resolved hex, or the worst stop of its gradient
agentFields.measuredContrast: computed ratio of the asset's strongest authored element over hostSurfaceHex
agentFields.fallbackAssetId: the record actually shipped after the ladder resolved, if it changed
